Dexter’s rewards

Receipt QR Reward Promotion

Terms for the chance to receive a free coffee or cake when an eligible Dexter’s Loyalty App receipt QR is scanned.

Promoter

Promoter: Dexters, 10A Dundasvale Court, Glasgow, G4 0JS, Scotland. The customer-facing brand may be displayed as Dexter’s. Contact hello@dextersspot.co.uk or 0141 473 5249.

How to take part

  • Place an eligible collection order through the Dexter’s Loyalty App.
  • The order must be completed and marked Collected.
  • Sign in to the same customer account and scan that order’s one-time receipt QR.
  • The first valid scan for that eligible order enters/checks the promotion. Repeated scans do not create extra entries.

No separate entry fee is charged. Customers pay the normal advertised price for their food whether or not this promotion is available. Dexter’s does not set or increase the price of food to reflect the opportunity to participate in this promotion.

Eligibility

The promotion is available to genuine Dexter’s Loyalty App customer accounts completing eligible app collection orders. Staff/admin test accounts, fraudulent accounts, duplicated receipts and technical-abuse attempts are not eligible through the customer claim route. Any age or geographic restriction introduced in future must be clearly stated before entry.

How results are determined

Eligible first-time receipt scans are processed automatically by the Dexter’s promotion system using the promotion mechanics configured for the relevant period. If a receipt is selected as a winner, the app assigns the prize shown. Dexter’s must administer the promotion fairly and must not alter a genuine result after entry except to correct fraud, duplicate use, tampering or an obvious technical error.

Prize

The prize is one free coffee or one free cake, as shown in the winning customer’s app. The prize is personal to the customer account, can be redeemed once, has no cash alternative and cannot be exchanged for cash. If the exact item is unavailable, Dexter’s may offer a reasonable equivalent of similar nature/value where appropriate.

Points are separate

Collection-order loyalty points and the receipt promotion are separate. A receipt QR may recover missing points where the system verifies they were not already credited, but it cannot award the same order’s points twice.

Promotion period and changes

The promotion started on 3 September 2026 and is currently ongoing without a fixed closing date. Dexter’s may close the promotion for future entries, but should communicate a closure or material change clearly in the app. Conditions affecting entries already validly made should be changed only where legally justified and fairly administered.

Misuse and technical faults

Dexter’s may reject or reverse entries/rewards created by fraud, tampering, duplicated receipts, manipulation, automated abuse or an obvious system error. A technical fault does not automatically create a right to a prize that was not validly awarded, but Dexter’s should investigate genuine customer reports fairly.

Consumer rights

Nothing in these promotion terms removes statutory rights relating to the underlying food order or any other rights that cannot lawfully be excluded.

Last reviewed: 4 September 2026. Significant promotional conditions should also be shown clearly in the app at or before participation, not only on this full-terms page.

Dexter’s promotion

Spin to Win Terms

Promoter

Promoter: Dexters, 10A Dundasvale Court, Glasgow, G4 0JS, Scotland. The customer-facing brand may be displayed as Dexter’s. Contact hello@dextersspot.co.uk or 0141 473 5249.

Eligibility and entry

Spin to Win is available to eligible signed-in Dexter’s Loyalty App customer accounts. Unless the app clearly states otherwise, each eligible customer account receives a maximum of one promotional spin per day. Staff/admin/test accounts and fraudulent or duplicate customer accounts are excluded.

No separate entry fee

No separate payment is charged to use an available Spin to Win entry. Any future promotion requiring a purchase, payment or alternative entry route must have separate terms reviewed before launch.

Prize schedule

The current configured prize schedule is:

  • one £2 discount on an eligible order over £10, assigned once at a randomly selected spin number between spins 50 and 250;
  • one free coffee and cake, assigned once at a randomly selected spin number between spins 250 and 500;
  • one free toastie, assigned once at a randomly selected spin number between spins 500 and 700;
  • one £2 discount on an eligible order over £10, assigned once at a randomly selected spin number between spins 700 and 999; and
  • at spin number 1000, one randomly selected eligible meal.

This cycle and any reset mechanic must operate exactly as configured and must not be represented in a misleading way. If the prize mechanic changes, these terms and the significant conditions shown in the app must be updated before the changed promotion is used.

Prize redemption

Winning rewards are personal to the winning account, have no cash alternative unless expressly stated, and may be redeemed once through the valid Dexter’s reward/QR redemption process. Any minimum spend, eligible-item category, expiry date or other restriction must be displayed clearly with the reward before redemption.

Availability and equivalents

Where a specific food prize is temporarily unavailable, Dexter’s may offer a reasonable equivalent of similar nature and value. A substitute should not materially reduce the advertised value of the prize without the customer’s agreement.

Fair administration

Dexter’s must administer the promotion fairly, keep the configured prize mechanism consistent during a live cycle, and must not retrospectively alter a valid result simply to avoid awarding a prize. Genuine entries should not be disadvantaged by later changes except where an exceptional change is legally justified and clearly communicated.

Misuse and technical faults

Dexter’s may reject or reverse entries or rewards resulting from fraud, tampering, duplicate accounts, automated abuse, manipulation or an obvious technical error. Technical faults should be investigated fairly; a fault does not by itself create a right to a prize not validly awarded.

Changes or ending the promotion

Dexter’s may end Spin to Win for future entries or replace it with another promotion. Material changes affecting eligibility, prize availability, entry limits or mechanics should be communicated clearly before they apply. Existing valid prizes should be honoured in accordance with their displayed conditions unless the law permits otherwise.

Consumer rights

Nothing in these terms affects statutory consumer rights relating to purchases made separately from the free promotional entry.

Last reviewed: 4 September 2026. Significant conditions must also be displayed clearly in the Spin to Win screen before participation.

Staff guidance

Legal & Compliance Checklist

Operational guidance for Dexter’s staff. Follow this alongside current recipes, allergen records, staff procedures and the customer-facing legal policies.

Allergens & food safety

  • Never guess whether an allergen is present.
  • Check the current written recipe, supplier label and allergen record, including sauces, sides, toppings and substitutions.
  • Allergen information must be available before an online order is completed and again when the food is supplied.
  • For serious allergies or coeliac requirements, check preparation and cross-contact risks before accepting the order.
  • If information cannot be verified, tell the customer rather than promising the food is safe.

Open customer Allergen Information

Customer orders & consumer rights

  • Make sure prices, compulsory charges, selected extras and collection details are clear before an order is submitted.
  • Do not add paid extras without the customer's active choice.
  • If Dexter’s cannot fulfil a paid order, provide the refund or other remedy legally due.
  • Do not refuse a valid statutory remedy because of wording in a promotion, deposit or refund policy.
  • Handle complaints fairly and keep useful order records where appropriate.

Terms & Conditions · Complaints Policy

UK GDPR & customer data

  • Only access customer information when needed for your role.
  • Do not share staff logins or customer information unnecessarily.
  • Never ask customers to send passwords or full payment-card details.
  • Use customer information only for the purposes Dexter’s has told customers about.
  • Pass privacy-rights requests, suspected account compromises or suspected data breaches to management promptly.
  • Remove or change staff access when roles change or employment ends.

Privacy & Data Protection · Cookie & Local Storage Policy

Promotions, points & rewards

  • Run Spin to Win and receipt promotions exactly as advertised.
  • Do not alter a genuine winning result to avoid awarding a prize.
  • Apply minimum spend, expiry and eligible-item restrictions exactly as displayed to the customer.
  • Prevent duplicate QR redemption and duplicate point awards.
  • Only reverse rewards for a genuine error, fraud, duplicate use, tampering or abuse.

Spin to Win Terms · Receipt Reward Terms

Sunday Roast pre-orders

  • The £4.99 deposit is part-payment, not an extra charge.
  • Follow the published cancellation and refund rules consistently.
  • If Dexter’s cancels or cannot supply the order, refund the amount legally due unless the customer agrees to an alternative.
  • Do not describe every deposit as automatically non-refundable.

Sunday Roast Deposit & Refund Policy

Security

  • Use individual staff accounts where provided and keep credentials private.
  • Do not leave staff/admin screens signed in on unattended devices.
  • Report suspicious logins, unusual QR activity, unauthorised access or possible data loss immediately.
  • Do not bypass security controls to make a customer transaction work.

When the app or business changes

Before launching a new payment method, marketing tracker, promotion, customer-data use, ordering method or other major feature, check whether the customer legal information needs updating first.

Staff guidance reviewed: 4 September 2026. This checklist supports compliance but does not replace statutory duties, food-safety procedures or professional legal advice where needed.

Pre-order information

Sunday Roast Deposit & Refund Policy

Deposit

A £4.99 deposit is required for each adult or kids Sunday Roast meal ordered. The deposit is part-payment of the meal price, not an additional charge. Extras do not create another £4.99 deposit unless clearly stated before ordering.

Remaining balance

The deposit is deducted from the full order total. The remaining balance is due on collection. Adult roast £14.99 = £4.99 deposit + £10.00 balance. Kids roast £9.99 = £4.99 deposit + £5.00 balance. Multiple meals and extras are calculated as the full order total less deposits already paid.

Customer cancellation

Sunday Roasts are fresh food prepared for a specific collection date/time and may fall within exceptions to ordinary distance-selling cancellation rights for rapidly perishable goods. If you need to cancel, contact Dexter’s as soon as possible. Where preparation has not begun and Dexter’s can reasonably release the reserved food/slot without loss, Dexter’s may refund the deposit. Once ingredients have been specifically committed, preparation has begun or the agreed collection time is imminent, the deposit may be retained to reflect the reserved food and preparation commitment, subject always to statutory rights.

Failure to collect

If a customer fails to collect at the agreed time without prior agreement, the deposit will normally be retained because food, preparation time and a collection slot were reserved for that order. Any amount retained must not remove a remedy the customer is legally entitled to.

When Dexter’s cancels or cannot fulfil

If Dexter’s cancels the order or cannot provide the ordered meal, the applicable deposit and any other amount paid for the unavailable order will be refunded through the appropriate payment route unless the customer voluntarily accepts an agreed alternative.

Problems with the food or service

Nothing in this policy limits rights where food is unsafe, faulty, not as described, or where a service is not supplied with reasonable care and skill. Contact Dexter’s promptly so the issue can be investigated and an appropriate remedy provided where due.

Failed or incomplete payment

A Sunday Roast order is not confirmed until the required deposit is successfully processed and the ordering flow confirms acceptance. If payment fails, is cancelled or expires, no confirmed pre-order is created unless Dexter’s separately confirms otherwise.

Collection and loyalty points

The outstanding balance must be paid before the order is treated as fully paid/collected. Eligible loyalty points are awarded under the current Loyalty Programme rules once the qualifying order is completed.

Allergens

Review Allergen Information before placing the pre-order. Allergen information must be available before purchase is concluded and again when the food is supplied.

Contact

Email hello@dextersspot.co.uk or call 0141 473 5249.

Last reviewed: 4 September 2026. Nothing in this policy excludes statutory rights under applicable UK consumer law.

Customer information

Terms & Conditions

These terms cover the Dexter’s website, Loyalty App, collection ordering, loyalty rewards, promotions and Sunday Roast pre-orders.

About Dexters and contact

Trader: Dexters, 10A Dundasvale Court, Glasgow, G4 0JS, Scotland. The customer-facing brand may be displayed as Dexter’s. Customer enquiries and complaints can be sent to hello@dextersspot.co.uk or by calling 0141 473 5249.

Before you order

  • Check the item description, price, quantity, modifiers, allergens, collection time and contact details before submitting.
  • The total price, including compulsory charges and selected extras, must be shown before you place the order.
  • Optional paid extras must not be pre-selected without your consent.
  • Customers must have a reasonable opportunity to correct input errors before submitting an online order.

Order acceptance

Submitting an order is an offer to buy. A contract is formed only when Dexter’s accepts or confirms the order through the relevant ordering flow or confirmation message. If an item becomes unavailable or Dexter’s cannot fulfil an order, Dexter’s may reject or cancel it and will notify the customer where reasonably possible.

Allergens

Customers with allergies, intolerances or coeliac disease must review the Allergen Information before ordering. Mandatory allergen information must be available before the purchase is concluded and again when the food is supplied. If the required item-specific information is not shown online, contact Dexter’s before placing the order so the current written allergen information can be checked. Staff must never guess about allergens.

Prices and payment

Prices shown are in pounds sterling and should include applicable taxes. Payment may be handled by third-party payment providers such as Stripe. Full payment-card details are processed by the payment provider and are not intended to be stored by Dexter’s.

Collection times

Collection times are estimates unless Dexter’s expressly confirms a fixed time. Kitchen demand, equipment failure, ingredient availability and circumstances outside Dexter’s reasonable control may cause delay. Dexter’s will take reasonable steps to minimise delay and keep the customer informed where appropriate.

Cancellations, refunds and consumer rights

Fresh food prepared to order and rapidly perishable goods may fall within legal exceptions to ordinary distance-selling cancellation rights. Services or food prepared for a specific collection time may also be affected once performance or preparation has begun. This does not remove any statutory rights relating to goods or services that are faulty, unsafe, not as described, not supplied with reasonable care and skill, or otherwise give rise to a legal remedy. If Dexter’s cancels or cannot fulfil a paid order, any refund legally due will be returned through the appropriate payment route.

Sunday Roast pre-orders

Where shown at checkout, Sunday Roast pre-orders require the stated deposit per meal, with the balance due on collection. The Sunday Roast Deposit & Refund Policy forms part of these terms. Nothing in that policy excludes rights that cannot lawfully be excluded.

Loyalty points, stamps and rewards

  • Rewards are personal to the customer account unless Dexter’s states otherwise.
  • Points, stamps and rewards have no cash value unless expressly stated.
  • Points are awarded only under the current loyalty rules and may be corrected where a genuine technical or recording error occurred.
  • Dexter’s may refuse or reverse benefits obtained through fraud, duplicate use, tampering, technical abuse or obvious error.
  • Single-use QR rewards become unavailable after valid redemption.

Promotions

Promotions, including Spin to Win and receipt-QR promotions, are subject to their own clearly accessible terms. Significant conditions such as eligibility, entry method, limits, prize details, expiry or closing arrangements and redemption rules must be communicated clearly before or at entry. See Spin to Win Terms and Receipt QR Reward Promotion Terms.

Account use and security

Customers are responsible for keeping sign-in credentials secure and providing accurate information. Dexter’s may temporarily suspend access where reasonably necessary to protect customers, investigate misuse, prevent fraud or address a security incident.

Service availability

The website or app may occasionally be unavailable for maintenance, updates, internet failures or outages. Dexter’s will take reasonable steps to restore service but does not guarantee uninterrupted availability.

Liability

Nothing in these terms excludes or limits liability where the law does not permit exclusion or limitation, including liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence, fraud or fraudulent misrepresentation, or customers’ statutory consumer rights. Any other limitation applies only to the extent permitted by law.

Law and complaints

These Terms are governed by the laws of Scotland. Customers should contact Dexter’s first so the business has an opportunity to investigate and resolve a complaint. Nothing in these Terms affects statutory rights under UK consumer law or any right to use available court, regulatory or consumer remedies. See the Complaints Policy.
